name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
summary: At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike guards central Ashenvale. She protects the sanctuary and nearby waters from rogue elementals and foul sorcerers, keeping their magic from corrupting the ancient woodland.

sections.title: Guardian of Silverwind
sections.body: At Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike keeps watch from Silverwind Refuge. Night elf sentinels across Ashenvale work to preserve the forest's balance and defend elven sanctuaries. Silverwind Refuge offers travelers a place to rest in the central woods, and Velene helps keep the area safe.

sections.title: Disturbances at Mystral Lake
sections.body: Peace around Silverwind Refuge can be easily disturbed. Velene watches Mystral Lake, where unruly elemental spirits and reckless mage summoners upset the wilderness. She directs champions against rogue water elementals and the careless spellcasters who disturb the spirits of the land.

faq.q: Where is Sentinel Velene Starstrike located?
faq.answer: Sentinel Velene Starstrike is stationed at Silverwind Refuge in central Ashenvale, near the southeastern shore of Mystral Lake.

faq.q: What tasks does Sentinel Velene assign?
faq.answer: Velene sends adventurers to gather bracers from restless elementals and stop the rogue summoners stirring trouble in the waters around Mystral Lake.

faq.q: What is the threat at Mystral Lake?
aliases: why are elementals at mystral lake
faq.answer: Aggressive water elementals trouble Mystral Lake, stirred up and exploited by mortal mage summoners who practice without regard for the forest's balance.

faq.q: Is Velene related to anyone else in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Velene shares the Starstrike surname with Layo Starstrike, a night elf stationed far to the south in Silithus. They may belong to the same lineage or house.
Silverwind Refuge is a night elf retreat on the shores of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. It offers a haven and a tactical outpost for Sentinels and allied travelers crossing the forest's wild interior.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels care about elemental activity?
aliases: why do night elves fight elementals
faq.answer: Night elves regard the wilderness as a sacred, living ecosystem. Violent or corrupted elementals disrupt wildlife and waterways, so the Sentinels intervene to restore balance.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Velene's commitment to guarding Ashenvale from reckless magic and protecting the forest's balance.
As an Alliance traveler, you can find safety at Silverwind Refuge along a dangerous road. Velene coordinates efforts to protect central Ashenvale.
As a mage, you may find Velene has little patience for reckless spellcasters whose conjurations stir local elementals and foul natural waters.
